item.title: Several Penn State Defenders and Specialists Named to All-Big Ten Teams
item.description: Following the conclusion of the regular season, the Big Ten released its all-conference defense and special teams selections for the year. Penn State's list of honorees looks different than preseason expectations, with no selections to the first- or second-team defense. Defensive end Dani Dennis-Sutton earned third-team accolades after recording 38 tackles, 6.5 sacks, three forced fumbles and three blocked kicks/punts. item.title: Martin Stepping Down as Ferguson Township Manager
item.description: Updated 9:35 p.m. Dec. 3. Ferguson Township will soon be looking for a new manager. Township Manager Centrice Martin informed the Board of Supervisors that she will not seek renewal of her employment agreement when it expires in January, board chair Jeremie Thompson said at Tuesday night's meeting. item.title: Noodles & Company Closes State College Location After 13 Years
item.description: Noodles & Company’s only Centre County location permanently shut its doors on Wednesday after 13 years in business. According to a sign on its front door, the fast-casual chain restaurant at 244 W. College Ave. in downtown State College is permanently closed. item.title: Evey Resigning From Benner Township Board of Supervisors
item.description: A Benner Township supervisor is stepping down from the position with four years remaining in her term. Kathy Evey has submitted her resignation and the board will meet at 8:30 a.m. Thursday to formally accept it. Evey told StateCollege.com on Wednesday that she decided to resign for personal reasons and declined to go into further detail. item.description: It was Tuesday evening when State College Food Bank Executive Director Allayn Beck noticed the surge in donations. item.title: St. Mark Lutheran Hosts Holiday Open House Event
item.description: St. Mark Lutheran Church, 850 Snydertown Road, Howard, brings back its Holiday Open House event on Dec. 6. The event will run from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. and includes an appearance by and photo opportunities with Santa and Mrs. Claus. item.title: Curtin Village to Host Annual Holiday Event
item.description: Curtin Village will hold its annual Christmas at Curtin holiday event from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 6 and on Sunday, Dec. 7 from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. at 251 Curtin Village Road, Howard. item.title: ClearWater Conservancy to Open 28th Art & Chocolate Exhibition at 3 Dots During First Friday
item.description: ClearWater Conservancy will open its Art & Chocolate 2026 exhibition with a reception from 4 to 8 p.m. Friday, Dec. 5 at 3 Dots Downtown as part of the First Friday celebration in Downtown State College. The exhibition features artwork donated by local artists in support of ClearWater’s mission to protect and restore natural landscapes in Centre County.
